propositions: The rebar-debug skill identifies root causes but does not record which originating ticket introduced the defect before closing the bug

Absent an explicit --caused-by flag, the fallback blame derivation attributes defects to whoever wrote most of the file rather than who introduced the defect, and misses cases where the fix site differs from the cause site

The skill must add a required attribution step to Phase 1 Stage 3 that traces implicated lines through git history, handles the unmet-obligation case via date testing and producer-side search, and routes the originating ticket ID through --caused-by on the bug close

The --caused-by flag must be required on close even when the caused_by link was already recorded separately, because transition_close.py calls blame.derive_caused_by unconditionally when the flag is empty and adds a second guessed edge

Worktree bootstrap in both rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills must use make worktree name=<branch> instead of bare git worktree add, and every command must run with the worktree venv first on PATH to avoid pre-commit hook failures
